flagged.comment: No dedicated Paving Plan sheet submitted with site plan. Sheet 22 (Construction Details 1) contains standard construction details for curbs, sidewalks, and driveways but is not a paving plan. A comprehensive paving plan showing the overall layout and extent of all proposed paving areas with dimensions, slopes, and material specifications is required.

No dedicated paving plan sheet submitted with the site plan. Paving details and specifications are distributed across the Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) and Construction Details sheets (Sheets 22-28), rather than being consolidated on a single paving plan sheet as required.

Legend is not shown on the site plan sheet itself (Sheet 9). While Sheet 3 (General Notes) contains a comprehensive legend defining symbols for utilities, easements, and other features, this legend is not present on the primary site plan sheet where these symbols are used. A legend explaining line weights, symbols, and visual distinctions between existing and proposed elements should appear on Sheet 9.

Legends are not shown on the site plan sheet itself. While legends are provided on Sheet 3 (General Notes) and Sheet 11 (Grading Plan), Sheet 9 (the primary Site Plan) lacks a legend defining line types, symbols, colors, and hatching patterns used to distinguish features on that drawing.
areas: Site plan sheet and grading/dimension control sheets

flagged.comment: Vicinity plan (location map on cover sheet) does not outline the class of every building/structure in the vicinity. The map shows adjacent property boundaries and structures but does not label zoning classifications (SF-3, GO, MF-3, etc.) or land use designations for adjacent buildings, making it impossible to understand the surrounding development context from the plan alone.
areas: Project location map and vicinity area

flagged.comment: Vicinity plan not provided showing the class of every building/structure in the vicinity of the project site. The site location map on the cover sheet identifies surrounding parcels and streets but does not classify the buildings or structures in the vicinity.

Figure 2.5.1 (site development regulations showing setbacks, building coverage, impervious cover allowances, and other zoning requirements) is not provided with the site plan. This figure, which displays the applicable development standards for the MF-2 zoning, must be included as a legible copy attached to the plan set for verification of compliance.
areas: Cover sheet and plan set documentation

flagged.comment: Figure 2.5.1 (site regulations) required as a legible copy with the site plan application cannot be verified as present in the submitted plan set. No reference to Figure 2.5.1 was found in the sheet guides or content documentation.

Base, redeveloped, and new impervious cover are not shown with distinct shading and clear labeling. Sheet 13 (Drainage Area Map) shows existing and proposed drainage areas on separate maps and labels them with 'Ex' and 'Pro' prefixes, but impervious cover areas within each map are not visually distinguished with distinct hatch patterns or shading. Numerical values appear only in tables; visual differentiation of base, redeveloped, and new impervious cover on the plan graphics themselves is absent.

Sheets 13-14 are listed as drainage area maps, but visual examination of whether base impervious cover, redeveloped impervious cover, and new impervious cover are shown with distinct shading and clear labeling could not be verified from the available text descriptions.
areas: Drainage area maps and impervious cover exhibits

flagged.comment: Overlay of the current proposed site plan not included on the demolition plan sheet. Sheet 8 shows existing site conditions with demolition callouts but does not include an overlay of the proposed site plan layout (proposed buildings, parking, utilities) to provide spatial context showing how demolition areas relate to future development. The demolition plan should be overlaid with proposed site plan elements to clarify the relationship between removal and new construction.

Demolition plan sheet does not include an overlay of the current/proposed site plan to provide spatial context for what is being removed. Sheet 8 shows existing conditions with demolition callouts but does not overlay the proposed site plan footprints and building locations, making it difficult to understand how the demolition relates to the final proposed development.

Sheet 9 title block shows SP-2023-0126C per vision analysis, but official documentation states SP-2025-0126C. The site plan number format SP-XXXX-XXXX appears correct where visible, but the year discrepancy between sheets (2023 vs 2025) cannot be verified without examining the actual source document. Landscape sheets 30-31 use project number format (013-25-01) instead of SP-XXXX-XXXX format.
areas: Sheet 9 (Site Plan) and potentially other sheets

flagged.comment: Scale verification completed for plan sheets (1" = 20') and location map (1" = 400'), but utility plan-profile sheets (19-20) and standard details sheets (23-28) were not examined visually to confirm scale legibility and format on all sheets.

Sheet sizes confirmed as 24" × 36" for Sheets 21-22. However, sheet sizes for utility sheets 19-20 and landscape sheets 30-31 (which show inconsistent numbering 27-28 of 35) were not verified. Landscape sheets may be from a separate document set with different sizing standards.

Existing and proposed land uses are not shown on the cover sheet. The cover sheet identifies the project as 'Valley View Townhomes' and indicates R3 occupancy classification, but does not provide a summary listing existing conditions versus proposed multi-family residential use.

Adjoining land uses not labeled on site plan or location map. Adjacent properties include SF-3, GO, MF-3, MF-3-CO, and MF-2-CO zoning per project records, but these zoning designations and use classifications are not shown on the plan sheets. The location map shows adjacent property boundaries and structures but provides no labels identifying the use class of each adjacent property.

The overall site plan sheet is too congested to show adequate detail at required scale. The single sheet attempts to display the site plan drawing with all buildings, utilities, and infrastructure along with five data tables, eight text note blocks, benchmark data, and detailed lighting figures, resulting in highly dense visual presentation with minimal white space. Information should be distributed across multiple sheets to ensure clarity and legibility at the required scale.

Sheet 29 is labeled 'Addressing Plan' showing proposed unit numbers within buildings but is not a formally approved addressed layout document. An Approved Addressed Layout signed or stamped by the City of Austin Development Services Department must be attached to the plan set as documentation that the proposed addresses have been approved by the city.

Location map exists on cover sheet with north arrow, but visual clarity and whether site location is sufficiently clear relative to surrounding context could not be fully verified without examining the source document.

The primary site plan (Sheet 9) does not clearly distinguish existing conditions from proposed development. While Sheet 4 shows existing conditions and Sheet 8 shows demolition, the main Site Plan (Sheet 9) does not use consistent visual treatment (colors, line weights, symbols, labeling, or graying) to distinguish proposed buildings and improvements from any existing conditions that remain or are referenced. Linework and features lack clear visual segregation.
areas: Overall site plan sheets and proposed development sheets

flagged.comment: Sheet 4 is labeled 'Existing Conditions Survey' and the guide indicates it shows existing topography and existing conditions. However, visual verification that the sheet reflects current (not proposed) grades and layout, and whether it is clearly distinguished from the demolition plan, requires examination of the actual source document.

Existing Conditions Sheet (Sheet 4) does not clearly identify and label which improvements from prior site plans will remain and which will be demolished. The prior site plan (SP-97-0145CS) included a nursing care facility demolished in June 2022; however, Sheet 4 does not explicitly label 'To Remain' or 'Will be Demolished' for any improvements from prior site plans. This information must be clearly documented on the Existing Conditions Sheet or Demolition Plan with explicit labeling.
